name: Module13.2 QRCode
summary: Decodes printed or displayed barcodes into text; separate from the Core camera.

host_bindings.notes: Candidate UART route: select QR_TX to M5-Bus pin15 (Core RX18), QR_RX to pin16 (Core TX17); disconnect alternative UART routes. Verify actual DIP labels and orientation before power-up. The scanner uses these PORT.C signals; do not connect another UART peripheral to them. The vendor separately reports both routing banks at 3 ON / 1,2,4 OFF for this route; check actual switch labels before applying it. Do not select routes onto CoreS3 GPIO13/14 used by audio.

support.meaning: Primary-source review plus separately labeled vendor bench notes. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented; vendor results are not plugin physical acceptance.

first_hardware_check: Confirm exact M145, stack orientation and screws with power disconnected. DinBase assembly/order needs a physical fit check.
Select UART and the reviewed DIP route; initialize M5Unified, internal I2C expander and M5Module-QRCode with explicit RX/TX. Defaults/examples target other boards.
Trigger a scan; display a harmless test payload; stop scanning and keep touch responsive. Use USB mode only as a separate host workflow.
troubleshooting: A beep alone does not prove the app received data; check UART and switch mode.
The I2C 0x43 expander controls power/trigger; it does not carry decoded text.
PORT.C changes function in USB mode. Do not treat it as an ordinary Grove UART at the same time.

The CoreS3 body red PORT.A (GPIO2/1) differs from M145 red PORT.A, which the module pinmap connects to internal M5-Bus I2C (CoreS3 GPIO12/11). Identify which physical connector is being used; do not assume identical colors mean identical buses.
Keep M5.In_I2C ownership for the 0x43 expander. Do not replace it with a fresh Wire.begin on the internal bus.
Power down before moving routing switches or restacking. Check speaker playback after scanner routing to catch shared audio pins.

app_fixture_plan.note: Use explicitly labeled app-owned text fixtures if requested; there is no scanner emulator. Bound payload size and treat scanned text as data, never commands.

libraries.name: M5Module-QRCode
libraries.author: M5Stack
libraries.purpose: UART decode and expander control; reviewed source uses M5.In_I2C and 115200 baud.

vendor_bench_report.scope: Reported observations from a separate vendor build; not plugin driver or physical acceptance.
notes: Vendor tested UART mode with switch 3 ON and 1, 2, 4 OFF in each of the two routing banks, for CoreS3 RX18/TX17.
Confirm switch numbering/orientation on the actual module against the schematic. Some alternate routes land on CoreS3 audio signals, including GPIO13.
Trigger-mode settings sent by protocol can persist on the scanner; inspect mode before changing it.
A raw-image transfer took about 27 seconds in the vendor build. Use decoded text for a first app; this observation is not a streaming-camera capability.
